Short answer

To install nautilus-open-any-terminal on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add nautilus-open-any-terminal. It is a 26.6 KB download (85.6 KB installed), version 0.8.2-1, licensed GPL3. context-menu entry for opening other terminal in nautilus. Free and open source.

Install nautilus-open-any-terminal on Omarchy

A small Nautilus (and Caja) extension that adds an "Open Terminal Here" context-menu entry, but lets you choose which of 40+ terminal emulators it launches, such as Kitty, Alacritty, Konsole, or Tilix, instead of being stuck with GNOME Terminal. It also supports custom launch commands for more specialized setups.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add nautilus-open-any-terminal
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.8.2-1:
    pacman -Qi nautilus-open-any-terminal

Open and use nautilus-open-any-terminal

nautilus-open-any-terminal has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql nautilus-open-any-terminal | grep /usr/bin/

nautilus-open-any-terminal requirements and compatibility

  • Nautilus or Caja file manager
  • nautilus-python (or python3-nautilus) support
  • A terminal emulator to launch

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • python-nautilus

Pricing and license

Free and open source. License: GPL3.

Uninstall nautilus-open-any-terminal

omarchy pkg drop nautilus-open-any-terminal

Frequently asked questions

How do I install nautilus-open-any-terminal on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add nautilus-open-any-terminal. The download is 26.6 KB and it takes 85.6 KB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is nautilus-open-any-terminal free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed GPL3.

How do I uninstall nautilus-open-any-terminal?

Run omarchy pkg drop nautilus-open-any-terminal. It removes the package from your system.

What does nautilus-open-any-terminal depend on?

The package declares 1 dependency: python-nautilus. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is nautilus-open-any-terminal a desktop app?

No. nautilus-open-any-terminal has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is nautilus-open-any-terminal in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as nautilus-open-any-terminal (version 0.8.2-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Felix Bühler makes it. Project site: https://github.com/Stunkymonkey/nautilus-open-any-terminal.
